name: portfolio_policy-decision-outcomes
notes: ADR-0279 Stage 4, the feedback loop: an earlier run's decisions (published back through onboarding, one stream per run file) against a later positions snapshot -> per-symbol projected vs realized per-share growth. Only the hold forecast is scored here; the active side is scored in the child that runs it. The decision run name and the observation date are values of THIS document: scoring a different run or date is a different experiment.

decisions.notes: Role 'data': the decisions/<run>.jsonl file the decision run wrote, acquired through the localtables connector (layout file: the stream is the file stem = the run name). Set stream to the run being scored.

positions.notes: Role 'data': every positions snapshot acquired so far; the filter below picks the one observation date.

later.notes: The observation date, declared: one snapshot, so the elapsed time is one number. Set it to a day a positions pull exists for.

outcomes.notes: Joined on account + symbol (one symbol in two accounts is two positions). Per-share growth (market_value / long_quantity) so a buy or a sell between the two dates is not read as a return; surprise = realized - projected (pro rata for the elapsed fraction of horizon_years).

params.source: hold-forecast outcomes per symbol: projected vs realized growth

scored.notes: Role 'report': one file per scoring run under ./outcomes.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Placement is not identity.
